activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1956 as Borlaug's representative Mexican scientific-activity year. His wheat-improvement work in Mexico contributed to the country becoming self-sufficient in wheat that year, a key precursor of the Green Revolution.

sources.title: Norman Borlaug – Facts — NobelPrize.org
sources.citation_text: NobelPrize.org records Borlaug's wheat research in Mexico during the 1940s and 1950s and states that Mexico became self-sufficient in wheat by 1956.
